summary: Produce pinned read-only analyzer snapshots with atomic publication

delivery.outcome: Deliver reusable module and python -m command that scans an exact Git-bound isolated input projection with pinned code2llm/redup/prefact, records every process outcome and schema/config/scope hash, validates complete snapshots before atomic publication, and preserves prior current pointer on any incomplete or stale stage; test and protected merge.
nonGoals: No source changes in non-Git workspace project2.sh; governed replacement home is existing Wellman
No analyzer upgrade/install during observation, no runtime dependency or CI/hook/authority changes
No effectful standard adoption; scanner receipts bind observations but never trusted conformance or deployment authority
No changes to preserved foreign tickets/worktrees

architecture.decision: Reuse merged inventories, report adapters and observation schemas; isolated per-tool exact copies prevent source/config contamination. Separate externally pinned analyzer environment from runtime. Publish only a validated complete immutable batch under lock and atomic current pointer; retain failed attempt diagnostics.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert; immutable prior snapshot remains available.

validation.evidence: Version mismatch, failed/timeout/missing/partial reports, symlinks, source/projection changes, common exclusions and pointer failure preserve last complete snapshot; actual analyzer smoke checks.
Full suite and Ruff/governance pass; protected exact-head independent approval/merge.
